thread:
mira: Heads up — discovered an S3 artifact with a Vault-wrapped blob (seems like an old backup). Not confirmed exfil, but it contains ciphertext that unwraps with our backup KMS key. Starting containment.
jon: on it. can you paste the object path? I'll pull logs and check who accessed it.
mira: s3://redwood-backups/2024-09-12/agent_dump.enc
mira: quick ask: can we revoke the backup KMS key asap and rotate the vault transit key used for these backups? tldr: reduce blast radius.
tasha: +1 to key revoke. we should also add an audit-forwarder filter for any subsequent reads on that bucket and alert on decrypt calls to the KMS key.
ops-oncall: scheduling a short freeze on writes to that bucket. i'll enable object-level logging and ship to secure-audit for 72h.
jon: grabbing access logs now. initial grep shows three GETs this week from ci-runner-42 and one from a partner ingestion role.
sec-bot: automated note: KMS key redaction recommended. see playbook #keystore-evict v2.
mira: propose immediate steps:
1) revoke KMS key (create new key for restores)
2) rotate Vault transit and rewrap backups with new key
3) rotate any service accounts that had decrypt privileges (ci-runner-42, partner-ingest)
4) enable tight RBAC for vault-transit role and audit-log forwarder
jon: i'll open infra PR to rotate the CMK and create a new alias. linking PR in a sec.
jon: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/821 — changes CMK alias + adds key rotation schedule
mira: tasha, can you handle the Vault side? need a rewrap of artifacts and to revoke the old transit key grant from partner-ingest.
tasha: yes. plan:
- create new transit key in Vault: vault write -f transit/keys/backup-v2
- rewrap existing ciphertexts with /transit/rewrap using the new key
- remove grant: vault write sys/policies/acl -data '{"policy":"deny-partner-ingest"}'
snippet:
```
# rewrap example
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@agent_dump.enc key=backup-v2
```
jon: ops-oncall, pls note we need to rotate the IAM role tied to ci-runner-42. that will break running pipelines; schedule a maintenance window.
ops-oncall: noted. scheduling 30m window at 23:00 UTC. i'll put a notice in #deployments and set a brief rollback plan.
mira: also enabling audit stream for vault to the central SIEM with high priority tag so SOC can monitor any suspicious unwraps.
tasha: will add an event hook to trigger a ticket if vault transit/decrypt is called by any non-admin identity.
sec-bot: checklist status update:
- KMS revoke initiated: in-progress
- Vault transit creation: pending
- Service account rotation: pending
- Audit-forwarder: in-progress
mira: vulnerability triage note: not seeing evidence of exfil beyond the S3 GETs logged. still treating as potential leak until we rewrap and verify integrity.
jon: found an old CI token in the artifact metadata — rotating all CI tokens created before 2025-01-01 as precaution. starting churn for ci-runner pool.
tasha: will coordinate with dev teams for token churn. will post a matrix of affected jobs.
ops-oncall: backup restore path verified with new key; please do not re-enable the old alias. keeping it disabled until SOC clears.
mira: owning customer communication draft. short msg: "We identified a retained backup containing encrypted data. Keys have been rotated, and access controls tightened. No evidence of customer data exfiltration at this time."
jon: +1. save draft in incident-docs: https://confluence.internal/incident/keystore-1748001234
mira: final ask — everyone confirm completion in this thread when your bullet is done. i'll do a post-incident review and RBAC audit next week.
ops-oncall: KMS alias rotated and old key scheduled for scheduled-destroy after 30 days — done.
jon: infra PR merged, ci-runner roles rotated, pipelines rekeyed — done.
tasha: vault rewrap completed for the affected artifacts. partner-ingest grant revoked. audit hook in place — done.
sec-bot: post-incident tasks queued: RBAC review, KMS policy tighten, SIEM alert tuning.
mira: thanks all. creating postmortem + remediation tickets. :thumbsup:
